response.justification: Bogdan Szabo is a versatile, experienced senior/staff engineer with strong full-stack, DLang, and infrastructure exposure, but he does not meet the core minimum qualifications for this role: he lacks 8 years of C++ experience (only brief C/C++ work at National Instruments and a bachelor's thesis project), has no demonstrated large-scale cloud compute platform leadership, and his career has been primarily web/product/full-stack focused rather than distributed systems, compute, storage, or hardware architecture at scale. While he has leadership, mentoring, and architecture experience in a broad sense, the specific technical domain and depth required for this C++-centric cloud compute platform lead role are largely absent.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level experience (15+ years) across many stacks, showing adaptability and strong engineering craftsmanship
Demonstrated mentoring, workshop-leading, and community-building experience (talks, courses, code katas)
Some distributed/low-latency systems experience (Dunnhumby, high-throughput microservices with DLang)
concerns: Minimal C++ experience (~6 months at National Instruments plus a thesis project), far short of the required 8 years
No evident experience with large-scale cloud compute platforms, hardware architecture, or storage systems central to this role
Career trajectory is broad full-stack/product engineering rather than deep infrastructure/platform technical leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of large-scale cloud compute/infrastructure platform leadership
Strong general engineering leadership and mentoring background
